item.title: Self-Hosted Email Bounce Management: Postal vs Stalwart vs Haraka (2026)
item.description: Email bounces are inevitable in any email-sending operation. Whether you’re running a newsletter, transactional email system, or marketing platform, understanding and managing bounce rates is critical for deliverability. Hard bounces (permanent delivery failures) damage your sender reputation, while soft bounces (temporary issues) require intelligent retry logic.
